changeRecord.title: constraint attached to too few nodes
changeRecord.target: constraint floor1: only slave B1.1 kept
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A rigid diaphragm or link is a kinematic assumption that decides how lateral load is shared: with it the connected nodes move as one rigid body and the load goes to the frames in proportion to their stiffness and position; without it each node moves on its own and the load follows the members. A node left out of the list is no longer carried by the diaphragm: the master's load enters the structure only through the remaining slaves and has to travel through the members to reach the frames that were disconnected.
changeRecord.precondition: a rigid constraint with at least two slaves
